questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Siemens Mobility and MerMec are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Siemens Mobility and/or MerMec.
If you are a customer of rolling stock diagnostics, what type(s) do you buy and why? In your response you may wish to address the characteristics and applications.
How closely do Siemens Mobility and MerMec compete for the supply of rolling stock diagnostics in Australia?

Identify and describe alternative suppliers of rolling stock diagnostics in Australia (including with reference to types of products supplied and how closely they compete with Siemens Mobility and/or MerMec).
To what extent do customers purchase both in-depot rolling stock diagnostics systems and wayside rolling stock diagnostics components (either from the same supplier, or from separate suppliers)?
To what extent do you consider either of Siemens Mobility or MerMec’s rolling stock diagnostics components to be a “must-have” or especially important?
If you are a customer of rail infrastructure diagnostic components, identify and describe the suppliers available to you in Australia and how closely they compete.

If you are a supplier of rolling stock, do you rely on access to MerMec’s diagnostics components in order to compete effectively in the supply of rolling stock? If so, specify which type of component, and why you require these to compete effectively?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
